wayricad.name: WayriCAD
wayricad.summary: Portable exports now recheck saved sources before publishing, while retaining the electrothermal and fabrication-review tools.
changes: Portable Web Export rejects stale component metadata and rechecks saved PCB, schematic and supported-model hashes before publishing an export.
Original-source hashes and exact embedded-byte hashes remain separate, including model-path transformations.
The suite retains shared steady rectilinear 3D electrothermal studies, primary-winding thermal feedback and imported fabrication-net short/open comparisons from 4.8.3.
wayricad.note: Export checks describe saved snapshots, not unsaved editor state or an operating-system file lock. Electrothermal and fabrication model limits remain in force.

spike.name: SPIKE
spike.summary: A clearer power-tree overview and a Geometry → basic PI handoff to the existing PCB resistive-network solver.
changes: Power-tree branches have direction, collapse, fit and zoom, with selection and evidence details. Inferred electrical paths still need review.
Geometry → basic PI passes normalized PCB copper to the existing routed DC solver and returns geometry-linked fields; it does not infer electrical properties from arbitrary STEP solids.
Saved thermal studies reopen in thermal setup. Workspace search, board-net controls and axis rotation rings have been refined.
spike.note: This source-only hotfix adds no installer or numerical kernel. Numerical review remains incomplete and the full Python suite does not pass; use the release record for the exact limits.

kicad_online.name: KiCad Online
kicad_online.summary: More focused review conversations, source-linked replies and a clearer sheet browser with Root and saved page badges.
changes: Compact review conversations keep comment content prominent, navigate to anchored drawings and show source-linked reply markers and areas.
The schematic explorer opens on Sheets, with Root and saved page badges. The minimap returns to its compact view after a sheet is chosen.
Project loading shows real stages with cancellation where supported. Manual extension update checks link to stores without reloading active review work.
Private-project discovery and authenticated website reads are improved; uncertain issue/discussion creation retains its receipt to guard against duplicate sends.
kicad_online.note: GitHub preview packages and store releases are separate. Android 1.98 is a development-signed APK for manual installation; it is not a Google Play release.

webview.name: KiCad WebView
webview.summary: Resizable Properties, linked contextual previews and matching saved-result palettes across 2D and 3D.
changes: Resize Properties without losing its scroll or focus, and inspect source-linked contextual previews with independent cameras.
Exact saved identities connect selections across views and focus 3D parts on their saved mounting side.
Saved-result palettes match across 2D fields, independent 3D scenes and registered board overlays.
Explicit text variables, bounded numeric expressions, horizontal schematic tables and cancellable staged loading are included.
webview.note: Read-only inspection of supported saved data. The viewer does not run a solver or establish physical-phone, universal GPU or numerical qualification. WayriCAD 4.8.4 portable exports retain their separately pinned WebView 0.6.0.
